remarks: MOVE RIGHT INTO this Beautifully Maintained 3 Bedroom, 2 Bath home featuring Living Room with Fireplace, updated Eat in Kitchen, Formal Dining Room, a Three Season Porch/Sunroom, and a Finished Basement with numerous recent upgrades throughout. The Home Boasts Brand New Vinyl Siding and a New Roof (2024), giving Excellent Curb Appeal and Peace of Mind for Years To Come. Inside you'll find Freshly Painted Rooms throughout (2026). Refinished Hardwood Floors and New Carpeting (2026), all creating a Bright Clean and Welcoming Atmosphere. The updated Kitchen offers Granite Countertops, New Stainless Steel Appliances along with Plenty of Space for Cooking and Entertaining. Bathrooms have been Tastefully Updated adding Modern Comfort and Style. Additional highlights include Finished Basement for Extra Living Space, Sunroom/ Three Season Porch Perfect for Relaxing and Having your Morning Coffee. The Newer Windows enhance both Efficiency and Natural Light. Step outside to a large level yard ideal for Gatherings, Gardening, or Play. With all these Recent Improvements in Fresh Style Living Spaces, this home is a truly Move-In Ready and waiting for its next owner. Easy commute and close to everything. Enjoy all that Norwalk has to offer.
